## Significance of `cohortED`

![](assets/img/package_workflow.png){alt="Package Workflow" style="width: 90%"}

## Potential Extensions (Later)

- Alternative Assessments
- Support Services
- Dropout vs. Graduation
- Chronic Absenteeism
- Any other **transition**!

## Recent Improvements

- Enhancing Processes
- Bolster Reporting
- Clarifying Support
- Defining Workflow

## Enhancing Processes

* Longitudinal-population descriptors
  + Describing the population in terms of cohorts
* Persistence-based analysis
  + Visualizing the changes in the population

## Bolster Reporting

* Auto-generated text
  + Compares output from analysis functions
  + Conditionally constructs responses
  + Combines responses for reporting
* User-oriented decisions
  + Suggest plots or tables
  + Based on conditional logic
* Report-ready output

## Clarifying Support

* Cleanly-structured documentation
  + Searchable website with explanations
  + Summaries with collapsible details
  
![](assets/img/documentation_screenshot.png){alt="Example Documentation" style="width: 90%"}

## Defining Workflow

* Well-defined structure
  + Additive functionality
  + Streamlined procedures
* Input-structuring tools
  + Facilitate formatting data
